text: Heather's got her flat viewing in Leith on Saturday, second one this month. She's sick of the commute from Livingston.
heather txt - didnt get the leith flat, someone outbid. gutted. try and ring her tmrw

Demi's cat Biscuit is having a lump removed on Thursday. She's beside herself about it, keeps saying he's too old for an anaesthetic. He's fourteen. Her partner Kiri is taking the morning off to drive them to the vet in Clapham because Demi can't face doing it alone, and they won't know if it's anything nasty till the biopsy comes back, maybe ten days after. Text her Thursday afternoon.
Catalina moves to Lisbon on the 3rd of November. Her partner Pedro is going out a fortnight later once his notice period's done.
Tadhg had his knee op last Tuesday, home now but on crutches for six weeks. Need to drop round with some food for him and Siobhan this weekend.

So Anjali was telling me her dad's having a bypass on 14 May, at the Royal Free, and her and her brother Kofi are taking turns staying over with her mum. She sounded exhausted honestly. Her mum doesn't drive. I said I'd do a lift one of the days, probably the Wednesday after.
Layla - new puppy!! cockapoo called Pickle. Picking him up Sunday.
Claire's mum fell and broke her wrist, cast on till 2nd Dec
remind me to ask Kiri how the house viewing in Bristol went, it was this morning
Aidan and Gemma got the keys to the new place in Didsbury on Friday. Housewarming 22/11, I'm bringing the wine.
Adebayo is vegan now, properly, not just weekdays. Note for the Christmas meal.

Gareth starts at the new hospital in Swansea in January, consultant post. His wife Uma is staying in Cardiff till the kids finish the school year. So he'll be renting a room in Mumbles Monday to Friday and driving back every weekend, which he's dreading in winter. Their youngest, Elif, has her GCSEs in the summer so they didn't want to move her mid-year.
Anil said the dog's op got cancelled, vet reckons the swelling went down on its own. So no surgery Monday after all.
Shira's nervous about her MRI next Tuesday, claustrophobic. Must text her that morning.
Bethany loves anything with foxes on it. Birthday's 9 March. Fox mug, fox socks, whatever.
Uma Smith from work, the one who does the payroll - she's moving to Nottingham to be near her sister. Last day is the 28th.
Mai rang. Her rabbit Clover died overnight, she found her this morning. Send her something nice, flowers maybe.
pick up prescription before 6, pharmacy shut tmrw
Booked the removal van for Saturday 8th. Still need boxes and tape and to cancel the broadband.
Siobhan's hip replacement is now 19 Nov not the 12th. She's relieved actually, gives her time to sort the dog.
Bao's into bouldering now, goes three nights a week. Wants climbing shoes for his birthday apparently, size 9.

Darius and Mia are flat hunting in Glasgow, they've got four viewings lined up next weekend. Mia's mum is helping with the deposit. Darius wants the West End, Mia wants somewhere with a garden for the dog, so that'll be fun. They're staying with his cousin in Partick on the Friday night and I said they could borrow the car.

voice note: right so Pedro, Catalina's Pedro not the one from football, he was saying his gran in Seville had a fall and she's in hospital, they think she might need a hip op. He's flying out tomorrow, not sure for how long. Ask him how she is when he's back, and maybe sort the cat feeding for them while he's away, Catalina's already out there.
Vanessa got the all clear from her scan! Nine months after the op.
Haruto Tanaka - moved into the flat upstairs last week, from Osaka originally. Works at the uni, robotics. Has a shiba called Momo.
Caitlin's dog Rolo turns ten on Sunday, she's doing a little party in the park. Daft but lovely.
Rafael told me his boss is retiring at Easter and he might go for the job. Don't forget to ask in a few weeks if he's applied.
Elif's cat Simit had his teeth out yesterday, eight of them. Eating soft food, grumpy but fine.
Ebony - kidney stones, in A&E Saturday night, discharged Sunday. Still sore. check in Thurs
Gemma's sister Bethany is having her baby by c-section on the 3rd of December, so Gemma's off work that whole week.
Hoang Nguyen, Darius's flatmate. Coeliac. Massive Arsenal fan.
Kofi's moving out of his mum's finally, signing for a studio in Peckham next Wednesday.
Need to ring the vet about Luna's booster, overdue since September.
Heather said her brother Aidan is having his gallbladder out on Friday. Day surgery. She's driving him.
Demi update: Biscuit came through fine, lump was benign. Huge relief. Collect him tomorrow 10am.
had coffee with Anjali and Layla. Layla's thinking about moving to Manchester for a fresh start after the breakup, nothing decided. Anjali's flat in Hackney has damp again, landlord useless.
Tadhg says Siobhan's struggling a bit with him laid up, she's doing everything. I should take her out for lunch, maybe Thursday.

Gareth's mum is in hospital with pneumonia, since Sunday. He's driving up to Wrexham tonight. Sounded really rattled on the phone, she's 84 and was on oxygen last night but a bit better this morning apparently. His sister Shira is already there. Ring him Wednesday, and if he's still up there maybe offer to walk the dog.
Claire mentioned she'd love a new plant stand for the hallway, the wobbly one finally gave up. Xmas idea.
Kiri got the house!! Completion 15/12 if the chain holds. Congrats card.
Adebayo's dad's 70th is on 6th June, big do in Lagos, the whole family's flying out on the 2nd.

Mai and Bao have adopted a retired greyhound called Dash, he arrives this Saturday. They've been prepping for weeks, baby gates, a massive bed, the lot. Bao's taken the whole of next week off to settle him in. Apparently greyhounds sleep like 18 hours a day so they're hoping he's chill with the cats. Mai's already bought him a winter coat, of course.
Rang Shira after the MRI. Results in two weeks. She sounded okay but tired. Text her on the 4th.
Anil Osei, Ebony's uncle. Retired teacher, lives in Accra half the year.
My dentist appt moved to next Tuesday 2:15. Rearrange the 1:1 with Uma.
Elif's flying to Istanbul on Monday for her cousin's wedding, back the 30th. Her neighbour is feeding Simit.

Long chat with Vanessa tonight. She's been offered a transfer to the Edinburgh office, starts 1 February, and she's torn because her husband Darius has only just got settled at his job here and their eldest started secondary in September. They're going up on the 14th to look at schools and a couple of rentals in Portobello. She asked if I knew anyone up there. Ask Heather, she lived in Leith for years.
Caitlin hates hospitals, absolutely hates them, so her mum's knee op on Monday is a whole thing. She's taking the day off to sit with her.
Haruto's flying back to Japan on Friday for three weeks, his grandad's not well. Asked me to water his plants.

Mia's dog swallowed a sock, emergency op last night. Ok now apparently but £1,800 and the insurance only covers half. Mia's been crying on and off all day, she found him collapsed when she got home from work. He's staying in overnight again and they'll see about discharge Friday morning. Darius is picking him up.
Big Gaz (Gareth) has a new rescue cat, Mrs Whiskers, ginger, missing one ear.
todo: meter readings, post the keys back to the letting agent, change address with the bank
Pedro and Catalina's flat sale fell through on Tuesday, buyer pulled out. They're relisting next week.
Uncle Kofi has his cataract surgery on the 21st, left eye first then the right one in the new year. Mum's taking him. Ring him the day after to see how it went.
Darius is learning Italian, does it on the train every morning. Proper serious about it.
Siobhan's retired guide dog Bramble is poorly, vet thinks it's his kidneys. Tests back Wednesday.

Bethany says her landlord is selling up and she's got two months to find somewhere. Panicking a bit, prices in Brighton are mad. Must send her that lettings link Hoang shared, and check in at the weekend to see how the search is going. Her partner Rafael's helping but he works nights.
Tadhg's physio is every Monday and Thursday till Christmas. Back to work 12 Jan hopefully.
Layla's moving date is the 30th, Manchester confirmed. Leaving do on the 25th at the Crown, Friday.
nothing much, quick catch up with Ebony on the phone, she's good.
